rules.rationale: Halogen substitution adds polarizable apolar surface with positive Hansch pi constants, a direct mechanistic driver of logP.
Aromatic carbon surface partitions favorably into octanol; aromatic-rich scaffolds dominate high-lipophilicity drug space.
Reverses the low-confidence donor-to-heteroatom source role: polar heteroatoms solvate in water and depress logD.
Heteroatom-rich with no halogen compensation is the most hydrophilic combination; interaction is mechanistically additive in polarity.

skill.hypothesis: Transfers classical partition mechanisms: halogen and aromatic surface raise lipophilicity, polar heteroatoms lower it, while downweighting the weak donor-to-heteroatom source role. Fails if ionizable groups dominate measured logD or normalization compresses halogen effects.
